description: Guidance for integrating offline map tiles with Tabiji safety data. GPS coordinates in safety profiles (embassies, hospitals) are WGS84 and compatible with all major mapping providers.
coordinateFormat: WGS84 (EPSG:4326). All lat/lng values in safety profiles are decimal degrees.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap + Leaflet.js
providers.description: Best for web/PWA apps. Cache tiles via service worker for offline use. Tabiji Kit uses this approach.

integrationGuide.offlineCaching: Pre-cache tiles at zoom 10-15 for target areas using the Leaflet.offline plugin (github.com/allartk/leaflet.offline). Each 256x256 tile is ~5-15KB; a city at z13 = ~200 tiles (~2MB).
integrationGuide.embassyMarker: Use embassy lat/lng from safety profile: L.marker([embassy.lat, embassy.lng]).bindPopup(embassy.name + ' ' + embassy.phone)
integrationGuide.hospitalMarker: No structured hospital coordinates in current safety profiles. Use geocoded data or embed hospital lat/lng if added to future profile versions.
integrationGuide.sampleCode: const map = L.map('map').setView([embassy.lat, embassy.lng], 13); L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors' }).addTo(map);

providers.name: Mapbox GL JS
providers.description: High-quality vector tiles with offline region download support. Best for native mobile apps.

integrationGuide.library: Mapbox GL JS (mapbox.com/mapbox-gljs) or Mapbox Maps SDK for iOS/Android
integrationGuide.offlineCaching: Use OfflineManager (iOS/Android SDK) to download regions: OfflineManager.shared.createTilePack(for: region). Supports up to 750 offline regions.
integrationGuide.embassyMarker: embassy.lat and embassy.lng from safety profile → MGLPointAnnotation (iOS) or LatLng (Android)
integrationGuide.hospitalMarker: No structured hospital coordinates in current safety profiles.

providers.name: Google Maps Platform
providers.tileCaching: not available for web; limited via Android/iOS SDK
providers.description: Excellent geocoding and POI data but no tile caching in web. Mobile SDKs support limited offline caching per user account (Google's offline maps feature). Not recommended for PWA offline use.

integrationGuide.library: Google Maps JavaScript API (for web), Google Maps SDK for iOS/Android
integrationGuide.tileUrl: managed by SDK — not user-cacheable in browser
integrationGuide.offlineCaching: Android/iOS: users can save offline areas via Google Maps app. SDK-level offline tile caching is not available. Avoid for PWA offline requirements.
integrationGuide.embassyMarker: new google.maps.Marker({ position: { lat: embassy.lat, lng: embassy.lng }, title: embassy.name })
integrationGuide.hospitalMarker: No structured hospital coordinates in current safety profiles.

providers.name: Apple Maps (MapKit JS)
providers.description: Available via MapKit JS for web and MapKit for iOS/macOS. No offline tile caching for web. iOS only — not suitable for Android or cross-platform PWA offline use.

integrationGuide.offlineCaching: Not available for web. iOS MapKit supports some caching but is not developer-controlled.
integrationGuide.embassyMarker: new mapkit.MarkerAnnotation(new mapkit.Coordinate(embassy.lat, embassy.lng), { title: embassy.name })
integrationGuide.hospitalMarker: No structured hospital coordinates in current safety profiles.

providers.name: HERE Maps
providers.tileCaching: HERE SDK for iOS/Android supports offline maps
providers.description: Strong offline support via HERE SDK. Good alternative to Mapbox for mobile apps needing offline routing and maps.

integrationGuide.library: HERE Maps JavaScript API (web), HERE SDK for iOS/Android
integrationGuide.offlineCaching: HERE SDK: use OfflineSearchEngine and offline map download via MapDownloader. Supports region-based downloads.
integrationGuide.embassyMarker: new H.map.Marker({ lat: embassy.lat, lng: embassy.lng })
integrationGuide.hospitalMarker: No structured hospital coordinates in current safety profiles.

tileEstimates.description: Approximate tile counts and download sizes for offline caching at common zoom levels
tileEstimates.recommendation: Cache z10-z13 for a country overview plus key city tiles at z14-z15. Total for one country: ~50-100MB.

coordinateFields.embassies: Each embassy in the embassies[] array has lat and lng fields (decimal degrees, WGS84). Use directly as map coordinates.
coordinateFields.hospitals: Not currently available in safety profiles. Hospital data is narrative (hospitalNotes) rather than structured coordinates.

usageNotes: All coordinate data in Tabiji safety profiles uses WGS84 (EPSG:4326) — compatible with all major mapping libraries without conversion.
Embassy coordinates are sourced from public records and may drift slightly from actual building locations. Always verify for production use.
For PWA offline use, OpenStreetMap + Leaflet.js is the only fully open, cost-free option that supports service worker tile caching.
Tile caching in service workers requires special handling of tile responses — see the Leaflet.offline plugin for a reference implementation.
